name: Hensel Unterteil_DK 04xx enclosure base
summary: Unterteil_DK 04xx enclosure base arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: Unterteil_DK 04xx is the drawing identifier for enclosure base in Hensel's ENYCASE enclosure and distribution-system STEP collection. An enclosure base forms the selected housing body. Its mounting interface, internal usable space and cable-entry faces must be coordinated with its separately selected lid and internal equipment.

For example, in a field junction box containing terminal rails, use the Unterteil_DK 04xx reference to coordinate base fixing, selected cable-entry faces and internal mounting. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as ENYCASE_DK_Unterteile/Unterteil_DK 04xx.stp for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep base fixing, selected cable-entry faces and internal mounting visible in the layout.

This reference concerns the named Unterteil_DK 04xx drawing and its enclosure base role. A drawing in the same collection is not automatic evidence of compatible terminals, mounts or electrical performance.
